Subject: RE: FW: VectorForge x Redwood — SDK integration + certification interest

Quick technical notes ahead of Friday:

- Integration points we should validate:
  * LangChain: LLWrapper & Agents — ensure adapter preserves streaming and token-level errors.
  * LlamaIndex: retriever hooks and node storage semantics (KV cache interplay).
  * Tracing: emit standardized trace spans (trace.id, request.id, model.variant) and events for prompt/template substitution.
  * Telemetry: expose per-call counters for token usage, latency, and truncation events.

- Risk areas:
  * Quantized model variants can change tokenization timing; we should include 1-2 model variants in the test matrix.
  * Prefix caching: need to confirm semantics for prefix reuse when using VectorForge prompt templates that do dynamic expansions.

- Proposed acceptance criteria (high level):
  1) Adapter can run LangChain examples end-to-end with streaming enabled and no dropped tokens.
  2) Tracing spans emitted for all calls and visible in our tracing UI (sandbox).
  3) No PII exfil via default prompt templates; VectorForge to provide test corpus.

Estimate: 2 sprints (2 engineers) to build + 1 sprint QA/certification if partners provide eval corpus and test vectors. I’ll prepare a short tech checklist to include in the MAP.

-Karthik
